    Get your decision

    Illinois decides within 30-45 days from the date you applied.

    Check Manage My Case

    Your official status lives in Manage My Case on Illinois ABE — check for any updates there.

    If approved

    Your state agency will explain how to use your benefits. Check your email, mail, and voicemail.

    If denied

    It's often fixable. Read the reason on your notice to learn how to appeal or correct any missing information.

Updating your step here only changes this page — never your actual application.
